trailers.overview: The story centers on Bima, a middle-class family head who initially had sincere intentions to improve his household’s financial situation to make his wife, Dewi, happy.  However, his curiosity led him to try a shortcut through online gambling. Starting with small, seemingly tempting wins, Bima instead finds himself trapped in a vicious cycle of high-interest online loans and harassment from debt collectors. This emotional strain triggers intense conflict and shatters the family’s previously stable harmony. Bima must face the bitter reality that his fleeting “wins” in online gambling ultimately lead to total defeat and financial ruin.
